articles.title: Lok Sabha seat freeze is no longer linked to population stabilisation
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II: Polity, Governance, Supreme Court Judgements, Bills & Govt Schemes
articles.keyPoints:
• The distribution of seats based on 1971 Census continued for 50 years for the reason that a readjustment would adversely affect the proportion of States that stabilised population.
• Population stability was a stated objective of the government.
• That link between population stability and Lok Sabha share has been removed in the 132nd Constitutional Amendment Bill
